# Code Anchors: Append-Only Decision Log

- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.ts` — the append-only enforcement: exactly one new entry per changed page against a base, prior entries verified untouched, and the byte-identity comparison for a change permitted only to append.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/validate-concepts.spec.ts` — pins both halves, including that an edit outside the gained entry fails while the entry itself may be anything.
